description: Balanced parameter templates for three-stage B1/RVAE/diffusion semantic-retention experiments. Run the mild, moderate and aggressive profiles together to cover risk severity without changing the existing matrix builder contract.
prompt_templates: A pedestrian hidden behind a {occluder} {side} suddenly emerges toward the ego path at {speed} m/s, creating a {risk} near-miss.
Create a {risk} occluded-pedestrian scene: the {occluder} {side} blocks ego's line of sight and the pedestrian darts from behind it into the ego lane at {speed} m/s.
The ego cannot initially see a pedestrian because a {occluder} {side} occludes the view; the pedestrian then rushes toward the ego path at {speed} m/s with {risk} timing.
Place a {occluder} {side} between ego and a hidden pedestrian. The pedestrian must emerge from the occluder toward the ego trajectory at {speed} m/s and form a {risk} conflict.
